description: JSON output of `rocky fulfill <product>` — the reconciler's stop report: how far the loop advanced, why it stopped, and the exact next command when one exists.

message.description: Why the loop stopped, in plain language.

next_command.description: The exact command that unblocks it, when one exists.

plan_id.description: The pinned plan, while one is in flight.

product.description: The product name the loop was asked to drive.

spec_digest.description: The approved spec digest the state was reached under, if any.

state.description: The state the record was left in (its wire tag, e.g. `"needs_input"`, `"proposed"`, `"observing"`, `"blocked"`).

title: FulfillOutput
